funding_view.implication: Undeployed $100m earns 3.85% ACT/360, about $10,694 per calendar day. Because I expect subsequent official fixings to grind higher toward the SR3Z6 4.32 / SR3H7 4.58 / SR3U7 4.755 path as the new 3.75-4.00 funds band beds in and US inflation/labor gauges stay hot (72/75), cash income itself is rising (about $12,000/day at 4.32, $12,722 at 4.58, $13,208 at 4.755). Opening duration, curve, or FX risk stops that compounding on deployed notional. Apparent edges do not beat a rising overnight hurdle: US 2Y 4.76 is only ~91bp over cash after a fully priced hike, with empty analogs and null yield-change paths; shorting the SR3 strip after the meeting is chasing a known event; fading AONIA's 37-51bp hike path on a 16-Sep housing story is timed after the news; NZDUSD at the 12.9th 1y percentile cannot be triangulated without NZ rates; CFTC/CME positioning is missing so crowding cannot be verified. Stay in cash until a discrepancy is expected to out-earn that rising SOFR stream with a dated invalidation.
funding_view.sr3_forward_view: The relevant paper-funding path is the exact-horizon SR3 strip, not a 5% assumption: SR3Z6 2026-12 implied 4.32 (+47bp vs 3.85 overnight), SR3H7 2027-03 implied 4.58 (+73bp), SR3U7 2027-09 implied 4.755 (+90.5bp). Front SR3U6 is 4.00; the delayed Sep 1m SOFR future SR1U26 still implies 3.75, which is already 10bp below the official 3.85 fixing. Realized accounting remains the NY Fed print only.

contribution.stance_summary: NO TRADE. Verified: official NY Fed SOFR is 3.85% effective 2026-09-17 ACT/360 after a 23bp jump from 3.62% on 2026-09-16; the Fed delivered a 25bp hike to 3.75-4.00% that futures had already assigned a greater-than-90% probability; SR3 exact-horizon implieds are SR3Z6 4.32 / SR3H7 4.58 / SR3U7 4.755; US 2Y/10Y sit at 4.76/5.01 (1y percentiles 99.8/99.6) with 2s10s at 25bp (1y percentile 0.20) and empty analog lists plus null 1d/1m/3m/5d yield changes; CA 2Y/10Y 3.27/3.83 against CORRA 2.29 with CRAH27 3.13 (+84bp); AU 2Y/10Y 4.999/5.348 against AONIA 4.35 with Dec 4.725 (+37.5bp) and Mar 4.86 (+51bp); NZ sovereign rates unavailable; CFTC/CME positioning unavailable; temperature gauges are repo-retained dashboard_v8 (US Inf/Lab/Act/Con 72/75/69/74). Inference: the September hike is known information now embedded in overnight SOFR and in the SR3 strip, so fading or chasing US duration, flattening 2s10s, fading AONIA hikes on the housing print, or buying cheap NZD without NZ rates is either priced, unfalsifiable, or missing a closing catalyst. Unknown: holder/flow, live gauges vs dashboard_v8, NZ curve, and post-hike 1d/1m sovereign path. Empty $100m cash earns the official fixing; no packet-supported expression clears that hurdle with defined invalidation.
